ACTION: General status indicating that an action has been performed.
ADMIN_USER: Indicates that an admin user action has been performed.
APACHE_CONFIG: Indicates that Apache configuration has been set.
APACHE_CONFIG_ERROR: Indicates an error in Apache configuration. Click on the information icon to learn the exact cause of this error.
BO_AUTH_CONFIG: Indicates that backoffice authentication configuration has been set.
BO_NOTIFICATION_CONFIG: Indicates that backoffice notification configuration has been set.
BRANDING: Indicates that branding configuration has been applied.
CLIENT: Indicates that a client configuration has been applied.
CLUSTER_NODE: Indicates that a cluster node action has been performed.
COMPONENT: Indicates that a component configuration has been set.
CUSTOM: Indicates that a custom action has been performed.
EMAIL_CONFIG: Indicates that email configuration has been set.
EMAIL_TEST: Indicates that an email test has been performed.
MGMT_ACCESS: Indicates that management access has been configured.
NOTIFICATION: Indicates that a notification has been sent.
PRODUCTS: Indicates that a products action has been performed.
REPORT: Indicates that a report action has been performed.
REQUIRED_ACTION: Indicates that a required action has been performed.
RESET_PASSWORD: Indicates that a password reset action has been performed.
RULE: Indicates that a rule action has been performed.
SMS_CONFIG: Indicates that SMS configuration has been set.
SMS_TEST: Indicates that an SMS test has been performed.
SUBSCRIPTION: Indicates that a subscription action has been performed.
USER: Indicates that a user action has been performed.
WHATSAPP_CONFIG: Indicates that WhatsApp configuration has been set.
WORKFLOW_ERROR: Indicates that a workflow error has occurred. Click on the information icon to learn the exact cause of this error.
WORKFLOW_ROLE: Indicates that a workflow role has been assigned.
WORKFLOW_SUCCEEDED: Indicates that a workflow has succeeded.
WORKFLOW_TRIGGERED: Indicates that a workflow has been triggered.
WORKSPACE: Indicates that a workspace action has been performed.
WORKSPACE_ROLE: Indicates that a workspace role has been assigned.
WORKSPACE_ROLE_MAPPING: Indicates that a workspace role mapping has been applied.
WORKSPACE_SCOPE_MAPPING: Indicates that a workspace scope mapping has been applied.
